title: SixGreatRings
description: Six great rings is a mod that will add a new layer to your Minecraft world! Made using Mcreator this mod was made to show how far you could go with something simple. Enjoy the new dimensions and worlds you can travel to, while discovering new ores!
body:
Six great rings is a mod that will add a new layer to your Minecraft world! Made using Mcreator this mod was made to show how far you could go with something simple. Enjoy the new dimensions and worlds you can travel to, while discovering new ores! 

New Things



Oranuim:  

A new ore that allows you to get a new type of Armor and tools as well as a  new wasteland world.



Rozin:

A new ore that allows you to get a new type of Armor and tools as well as a new beatiful world.



Zion:



A new ore that allows you to get a new type of Armor and lets you unlock the Confusing Edge Of Reality



World Of Riches



By mixing parts from ever world and fighting a boss you can make it to this world which I will not Spoil.
